notes: Six taḥwīl branches meet at «كل هؤلاء عن عبد الملك»; the names after the last branch are the shared tail, and the Prophet closes it
«حدثنا أبي كلاهما» gives the father as a bare relation: the father of Ubayd Allah b. Muadh, not named in the text, so it is not completed
«بمثل حديث أبي عوانة» is a wording remark naming another transmitter: a variant group, never a route
«وحدثناه يحيى بن يحيى، أخبرنا هشيم» is the first branch; the verb «وحدثناه» is not a name
